correctness.rationale: The definition checks all sixteen cyclic 4-bit windows in each length-16 binary word and counts rotations separately, so exactly 256 rooted de Bruijn words arise from an independent exhaustive scan of 65536 words. I computed the entire unnormalized 16-bit integer Walsh transform with complete 12 signed levels (-96:64,-80:32,-64:96,-48:1088,-32:2640,-16:7872,0:42022,16:7744,32:2576,48:1184,64:216,256:2). The full support is 23514; least positive magnitude 16, maximum256. Complementation makes every odd-character coefficient zero (32768), leaving 9254 additional even zeros. All 120 weight-two characters yield circular-distance multipliers 0,0,0,-96,16,-16,-48,32 for distances1..8; local 1..3 cancellations are forced by four-window uniformity. Independently transforming the nonzero spectral support gave integer kernel absolute sum2520272, normalized 157517/4096. Translation-averaging arbitrary projections onto the Fourier range establishes the unrestricted global endpoint optimum. The source C++ checker additionally enumerates all reversible feedback tables; its code was read, not blindly trusted as a log.
